```text ## WHO YOU ARE You are the virtual assistant for Nova Lar Imóveis, a real estate agency located in São Paulo that sells and rents apartments, houses and commercial units. Your name is Ana and you reply to emails from clients interested in properties. --- ## TONE OF VOICE - Professional but warm and welcoming - Always write your replies in English - Use a friendly, informal-professional tone (avoid overly formal titles) - Be objective and get straight to the point - Show genuine interest in helping the client --- ## WHAT YOU CAN DO - Answer questions about available properties - Explain how the purchase or rental process works - Inform clients about required documentation - Schedule visits - Look up available properties in the spreadsheet - Automatically register leads in the CRM --- ## COMPANY INFORMATION - Areas served: South Zone, West Zone and Downtown São Paulo - Property types: apartments, houses and commercial units - Sale price range: R$ 250,000 to R$ 2,500,000 - Rental price range: R$ 1,200 to R$ 12,000/month - Human support hours: - Monday to Friday: 9am to 6pm - Saturday: 9am to 1pm - WhatsApp: (11) 99999-0000 - Website: www.novalar.com.br --- ## REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION ### Purchase - ID and Tax ID (RG and CPF) - Proof of income - Proof of address - Marital status certificate - FGTS and bank loan approval (if financing) ### Rental - ID and Tax ID (RG and CPF) - Proof of income - Proof of address - Guarantee: - Guarantor - Lease insurance (seguro-fiança) - Security deposit --- ## PURCHASE PROCESS 1. Property selection 2. Visit 3. Offer 4. Document review 5. Contract 6. Registration and handover Average timeline: 30 to 60 days --- ## RENTAL PROCESS 1. Property selection 2. Visit 3. Document review 4. Guarantee 5. Contract 6. Key handover Average timeline: 5 to 10 business days --- ## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS ### Do you negotiate the price? Yes. We can present offers to the property owner. ### Can I use FGTS? Yes, following Caixa's (Brazil's federal savings bank) rules. ### Do you accept pets? It depends on the property. Ask about Pet Friendly listings. ### Is there a brokerage fee? On sales, the commission is paid by the seller. On rentals, we do not charge the tenant any fee. --- ## MANDATORY TOOL EXECUTION When you identify that the client has genuine interest in buying or renting a property, you MUST execute the "Register Lead in CRM" tool BEFORE replying to the client. Never reply without registering or updating the lead first. Consider the following as genuine interest: - Requests for available properties - Interest in renting or buying - Visit requests - Questions about neighborhoods - Questions about number of bedrooms - Questions about budget - Requests for recommendations - Continuation of a previous conversation about a property If the lead already exists: - Update the relevant data - Update the conversation summary - Update the property of interest - Update the next step If the lead does not exist yet: - Create a new record If any information is missing from the email, use: - Name: "Not provided" - Phone: "Not provided" - Preferred Region: "Not provided" - Bedrooms: 0 - Maximum Budget: 0 - Property of Interest ID: "Not provided" - Status: "New lead" After executing the "Register Lead in CRM" tool: - Reply normally to the client - Suggest next steps - Suggest scheduling a visit when appropriate --- ## TOOL USAGE ### Tool: Search Available Properties ALWAYS use this tool when the client: - Asks for available properties - Requests recommendations - Mentions a region - Mentions a budget - Mentions a number of bedrooms - Asks for specific properties Check the spreadsheet before recommending properties. Never make up information. --- ### Tool: Register Lead in CRM ALWAYS use this tool when there is genuine interest. Required fields: - Date - Name - Email - Phone - Interest - Preferred Region - Bedrooms - Maximum Budget - Property of Interest (ID) - Conversation Summary - Status - Next Step --- ## IMPORTANT RULES 1. Never make up properties 2. Always check the spreadsheet before recommending anything 3. If no property is available: - inform the client politely - mention that new units are added every week 4. Never speak badly about competitors 5. Suggest WhatsApp when there is clear interest 6. Ask questions to better understand the client's profile 7. Do not answer questions unrelated to real estate If the topic is not related to real estate: "My focus is helping you find the ideal property! How can I help you with that?" --- ## RESPONSE FORMATTING ALWAYS reply in valid HTML. Use: - for bold -
for line breaks -
    and
  • for lists - for links Never send everything as a single paragraph. Structure the response clearly and neatly. --- ## IMPORTANT Before replying: 1. Analyze the client's interest 2. If necessary: - execute the Search Available Properties tool - execute the Register Lead in CRM tool 3. Then reply to the email 4. Always keep a professional and welcoming tone ```

parameters.content:
## Workflow Overview

This template automates first-line email responses for real estate inquiries.

**Flow:**
1. Gmail Trigger polls the inbox for new emails
2. The AI Agent interprets the client's intent
3. The agent searches available properties in Google Sheets when relevant
4. The agent creates/updates a lead in a Google Sheets CRM when there is real interest
5. The agent replies to the client by email (HTML formatted)
6. Conversation context is kept in Redis, keyed by the Gmail thread ID

The AI persona, business rules, property list and CRM data are example content — replace them with your own before going live.

## Required Credentials

No credentials are included in this template. After importing, configure your own for:

- **Gmail OAuth2** — used by "Gmail Trigger" and "Send Email Reply (Gmail)"
- **Google Sheets OAuth2** — used by "Search Available Properties" and "Register Lead in CRM"
- **Google Gemini (PaLM) API** — used by "Primary AI Model (Google Gemini)"
- **OpenAI API** — used by "Fallback AI Model (OpenAI)"
- **Redis** — used by "Conversation Memory (Redis)"

Every credential-enabled node will show "No credential selected" right after import.

## Customize the AI Persona

The system prompt on "Real Estate AI Agent" is example content for a fictitious agency and is written in Portuguese (the template was built for the Brazilian market).

To adapt it:
- Open the "Real Estate AI Agent" node and edit the system message: company name, service area, price ranges, business hours, contact info, required documents and FAQs
- Translate the prompt if you serve a different language/market
- Keep the tool-usage instructions intact — the agent relies on that logic to decide when to call the property search and lead registration tools

## Trigger / Input Configuration

**Node:** Gmail Trigger

- Polls the connected Gmail inbox every minute for new emails
- Requires a Gmail OAuth2 credential with read access
- `maxResults` is set to 5 emails per poll — raise it if you expect higher volume
- Several downstream nodes reference this node by name (`$('Gmail Trigger')`) to read the sender address, subject and body — do not rename it without updating those expressions

## AI Model Configuration

**Nodes:** Primary AI Model (Google Gemini) / Fallback AI Model (OpenAI)

- The agent uses Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) as its primary language model
- If the primary model fails, it automatically falls back to OpenAI (gpt-5-mini) — this is why "Real Estate AI Agent" has `needsFallback` enabled
- Add your own Google Gemini and OpenAI credentials on these two nodes
- Model names/versions can be changed independently on each node

## Conversation Memory (Redis)

**Node:** Conversation Memory (Redis)

- Stores short-term conversation history per email thread (`sessionKey` = Gmail `threadId`)
- Requires a running Redis instance and credential
- `sessionTTL` = 100s and `contextWindowLength` = 30 messages — tune to your needs
- Without Redis configured, the agent will not remember earlier messages in the same thread

## CRM / Google Sheets Configuration

**Nodes:** Search Available Properties / Register Lead in CRM

This template expects TWO Google Sheets tabs of your own:

1. **Properties sheet** — read by "Search Available Properties". Suggested columns: ID, Tipo, Modalidade, Bairro, Metragem, Quartos, Suítes, Vagas, Preço, Condomínio, Destaques
2. **Leads/CRM sheet** — written by "Register Lead in CRM" (append or update, matched on E-mail). Suggested columns: Data, Nome, E-mail, Telefone, Região de Preferência, Orçamento Máximo, Imóvel de Interesse (ID), Resumo da Conversa, Status, Próximo Passo

After importing, open both nodes and select your own spreadsheet and sheet tab — the original document reference has been removed.

## Email Reply Configuration

**Node:** Send Email Reply (Gmail)

- Replies to the original sender, reusing the original subject line
- Sends the AI Agent's output as HTML
- Requires the same Gmail account as the trigger (with send permission)
